9818.text:
9818 madhyāhna m. 'midday' Mn. [ mádhya-, áhar -] Pa. majjhanha -, °ṇha - m. 'midday', Pk. majjhaṇha -, °ṇṇa - m.; — Si. maddahana , maddāna (EGS 127) prob.
← Pa.; — S. mañjhandi < * madhyaṁdiva -. mādhyāhnika -. * madhyēṣṭha- 'standing in the middle'. [ madhyastha - Yājñ. — mádhya-, stha -] See * madhyayaṣṭi -.

9805.text:
9805 madhyáṁdina n. 'midday' RV. [ mádhya-, dina -] Pk. majjhiṁdina - n. 'id.' — Si. mädindina (ES 70)
prob. ← Sk. mā́dhyaṁdina -.

10039.text:
10039 * mādhyāhnaka-, mādhyāhnika - 'of midday' MārkP. [ madhyāhna -] Pk. majjhaṇhiya - 'of midday'; — S. mā̃jhā̃do m.
'lunch' prob. < * mādhyānta -.

9816.text:
9816 madhyānta '*near the middle'. [ mádhya-, ánta -] Pa. majjhantika - (with or without kāla - or samaya -)
m. 'midday', Pk. majjhaṁtia - n.; S. mañjhandi f. 'early
afternoon, midday meal' (but why - and - not - ānd - ?
Perh. rather < * madhyaṁdiva -, less likely < madhyāhna -). * mādhyānta -.
